newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia DCB unit gets listing approval.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia DCB unit gets listing approval.

text.p: DCB Sakura Merchant Bankers Bhd, a subsidiary of DCB Holdings Bhd, has received the Securities Commission's approval to list on the main board of the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange, its merchant bankers said.

The Securities Commission has approved a bonus issue of 258.02 million shares, restricted offer for sale of 50.73 million shares and issue to employees and directors of 28.52 million shares, a statement from Arab-Malaysian Merchant Bank Bhd said.

The regulator also approved the sale of 11.02 million DCB Sakura shares to public by director Abdul Rashid Hussain and by Rashid Hussain Bhd "of such number of shares to meet the required 25 percent public shareholding spread before the listing" of DCB Sakura.
The present issued and paid up capital of 338.65 million shares of one ringgit each have also been allowed to list on the KLSE.
DCB Holdings is in the midst of a major restructuring process, as part of which it is merging with itself the Kwong Yik Bhd banking group.
